headline: Zebra Technologies (ZBRA) Faces A 13% Fair Value Gap As Record Results Lift Guidance
summary: Zebra Technologies (ZBRA) reported record second quarter results, lifting both third quarter and full year 2026 guidance. The update highlighted strong demand across Connected Frontline and Asset Visibility & Automation, as well as contributions from recent acquisitions. See our latest analysis for Zebra Technologies. The earnings beat and higher guidance have shifted sentiment sharply, with Zebra Technologies’ share price up 61.33% over the past 90 days and a 19.63% total shareholder return...
